title_zh: v206：流式势函数正规 setup 在九相机 p14 上通过 fresh wall/RSS 资源门
title_en: v206: streamed potential-normal setup clears the fresh wall/RSS resource gate on all-nine p14
scope_zh: 仅限历史上已经暴露的 p14 开发轨迹、全部九相机、13 套标定与每套 101 帧；这是 post-open fresh-process 资源证据，不是 fresh validation、外部工况或真实 BOST。
scope_en: Limited to the historically exposed p14 development trajectory, all nine cameras, 13 calibrations, and 101 frames per calibration. This is post-open fresh-process resource evidence, not fresh validation, an external condition, or real BOST.

streamed_setup.description_zh: 按相机流式构造势函数正规方程所需状态，不再瞬时形成全相机稠密响应；保留 v205 的固定 1009 维非直流 DCT 表示与未修改 K1。
streamed_setup.description_en: The potential-normal state is constructed camera by camera without transiently forming the all-camera dense response, while retaining v205's fixed 1,009-dimensional non-DC DCT representation and unchanged K1.

interpretation_zh: v206 把 v205 尚未解决的瞬时稠密 setup 改成相机流式构造，并在随机相邻完整区组的 fresh worker 审计中，同时通过 wall 与三种 RSS 口径。相对稠密 K1，outer wall p50/p90 为 0.8603/0.8729，sampled whole-pipeline RSS p50/p90 为 0.7100/0.7370；相对 K2 分别为 0.7395/0.7503 与 0.7122/0.7339。
interpretation_en: v206 replaces v205's transient dense setup with camera-streamed construction and jointly clears wall-time and three RSS measures in randomized adjacent complete blocks of fresh workers. Versus dense K1, outer-wall p50/p90 ratios are 0.8603/0.8729 and sampled whole-pipeline RSS p50/p90 ratios are 0.7100/0.7370; versus K2 they are 0.7395/0.7503 and 0.7122/0.7339.
decision_boundary_zh: 这是 p14 已暴露开发轨迹上的九相机 post-open 资源 headroom，不是全局加速结论。五相机准确率仍未通过；流式 K1 相对稠密 K1 多一次 A^T，外部工况、曲线光路与真实 BOST 均未验证。
decision_boundary_en: This is all-nine, post-open resource headroom on the exposed p14 development trajectory, not a global speedup claim. Five-camera accuracy still fails; streamed K1 uses one extra AT versus dense K1, and external conditions, curved rays, and real BOST remain unvalidated.
next_scientific_gate_zh: 结果前冻结一个此前未打开的独立公开反应流工况，先验证同一九相机 matched-accuracy 与资源优势是否共同复现；五相机继续作为单独未解决的准确率门，不能由本轮资源正结果代替。
next_scientific_gate_en: Preregister a previously unopened independent public reacting-flow condition and test whether the same all-nine matched accuracy and resource advantage reproduce together. Five-camera accuracy remains a separate unresolved gate and cannot be replaced by this resource-positive result.
